name: Triazinetrisaminohexanoic Acid
description: Triazinetrisaminohexanoic Acid (CAS 80584-91-4 ) is a triazine-based chelating agent engineered to bind metal ions and inhibit corrosion in aggressive industrial environments. Its trifunctional amino acid architecture allows it to sequester multiple metal species simultaneously, making it effective where conventional chelants fall short in complex systems. In oil and gas operations, it functions as a corrosion inhibitor in produced water systems, pipelines, and acidizing treatments where metal ion contamination accelerates equipment degradation. Water treatment formulators incorporate it to sequester calcium, iron, and heavy metals in cooling towers and boiler systems, preventing scale deposition and fouling during operation. Textile and leather processing operations use it to chelate hardness ions in process baths, protecting dye uniformity and preventing metal-catalyzed fiber damage in the final product. In paper manufacturing, it controls transition metal content in pulp bleaching circuits, reducing peroxide decomposition and improving bleach efficiency across the production line. This chemical is typically supplied as an aqueous solution or dry powder. Technical-grade material is the standard commercial form, with concentration and purity specifications varying. Buyers sourcing for water treatment or oilfield applications should confirm active content and pH specifications against their formulation targets to ensure optimal performance.
